## CANDLE & GAPPS: Covariate Harmonization and Cleaning

This code performs Covariate harmonization and cleaning for CANDLE and PATHWAYS GAPPS cohorts to use in the Cell Proportions project evaluating placental cell proportions with birth outcomes (sPTB, GA, BW z-score, BW:PW, BWadj).

### Load Packages
```{r load packages, results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(growthstandards)
```

### Load Covariate Data
The older GAPPS covar version has gravidity and prenatl alochol
```{r load data}
gapps_covars <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/gapps_covariates_042524.csv")
candle_covars <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/p0108_CANDLECovariates.csv")
old_candle_covar <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/p0075_PAH_CANDLE_covariates.csv")
old_gapps_covar<-read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/p0047_gapps_older.csv")

CANDLE_Covariates3 <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/PWG_Methylome_GrantPrep_2026/CANDLEData/p0047_candle_fromMariana_miRNA.csv") #Use this for chorio preeclampsia, etc

gapps_AJOGvars <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/CovariateData/AdditionalGAPPsPerinatalData_FromAJOG2023/p0047_gapps_addition.csv") #Use this for cervical insufficiency

```

### Get RNAseq Batch Information
```{r batch organization}
#Load RNAseq Data to pull batch information
load(file="/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/OPE_and_PlacentalTranscriptome/Data/CANDLE_RNAseq/candle_20200226.Rdata")
candle_batch <- batches
candle_batch$pathways_id<-colnames(candle_lengthScaledTPM$counts)
candle_batch <- candle_batch %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, Analysis)
colnames(candle_batch) <- c("pathways_id", "batch")
load(file="/Volumes/paquette_a/GAPPSGrant_PrelimData/Resubmission_July2024/NEW_RawData/gapps_20240325.Rdata")
gapps_batch <- batches
gapps_batch$pathways_id<-colnames(lengthScaledTPM$counts)
gapps_batch <- gapps_batch %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, Analysis)
colnames(gapps_batch) <- c("pathways_id", "original_batch")


#Change GAPPS batch to 5-8 so that it doesn't match CANDLE
#Note: there are some duplicate samples that were run in two batches. In previous GAPPS analysis we removed those from the 4th batch based on this note from the Code ("remove the duplicates in the fourth batch for now (arrange by batch, ## then take only the first sample)")- Here I will do the same thing and remove the duplicates from the 4th batch.
gapps_batch <- gapps_batch[!(duplicated(gapps_batch$pathways_id) & gapps_batch$original_batch == 4), ]
summary(as.factor(gapps_batch$original_batch))
gapps_batch$batch <- recode(gapps_batch$original_batch, `1` = 5, `2` = 6, `3` = 7, `4` = 8)
summary(as.factor(gapps_batch$batch))
```


### Filter each dataset for the covariates that we need
Maternal Age: h_m_delivery_age (continuous) - need to pull from "old CANDLE" covars

Maternal Pre-pregnancy BMI: h_m_prepreg_bmi (continuous) 

Maternal Education: h_m_enroll_educ (factor)

Maternal Income: h_enroll_income (factor) - need to pull from older CANDLE covars 

Maternal Race: h_m_race (factor) 

Maternal Ethnicity: h_m_ethn  (factor) 

Fetal Sex: h_c_sex (factor)   

Parity: h_firstborn - will treat as a factor with two levels (primiparous, multiparous). 

Labor Type: cg_labor_type (factor) 

Delivery Method: h_del_method (factor) 

Smoking: Will combine h_m_enroll_smoke (factor) and cotinine (Y/N) into a new smoking composite variable which is Yes if either self-report or cotinine is positive.

Self-Report Alcohol: h_m_alcohol_prenatal (CANDLE-factor), m_pn_alc 

Gestational Age at Birth: h_birth_gestage_wks (CANDLE-continuous), h_birth_gestage. 
(GAPPS-continuous)

Birthweight: h_birthweight_g 

Placental Abruption (to use for exclusion): h_placental_abrupt

Placental weight: m_pl1_weight, mpl2_weight (continous) (GAPPS only!) 

Study Site: (categorical)

RNA sequencing batch: (categorical)- accounts for the fact that deconvolution was built off RNAseq data. The batch variable that we want to use is batches$Analysis

```{r select covars of interest}
#CANDLE
candle_main_selected_covars <- candle_covars %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, h_m_prepreg_bmi, h_m_enroll_educ, h_m_race, h_m_ethn, h_c_sex, h_firstborn, cg_labor_type, h_del_method, h_m_enroll_smoke, h_m_alcohol_prenatal, h_birth_gestage_wks, h_birthweight_g, h_placental_abrupt)
#Add study site to CANDLE since it's only one site (Memphis)
candle_main_selected_covars$site <- c("Memphis")

#GAPPS
#missing gravidity and alcohol (will pull from other gapps covars)
#Adding h_multi_gest which I'll need to use for filtering in Gapps only
gapps_main_selected_covars <- gapps_covars %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, h_m_delivery_age, h_m_prepreg_bmi, h_m_enroll_educ, h_m_race, h_m_ethn, h_c_sex, h_firstborn, cg_labor_type, h_del_method, h_m_enroll_smoke, h_birth_gestage, h_birthweight_g, h_placental_abrupt,  m_pl1_weight, m_pl2_weight, site, h_multi_gest)

#Old GAPPS
#need to pull gravidity and alcohol, and sPTB filtering criteria
oldgapps_selected_covars <- old_gapps_covar %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, m_pn_alc, m_chorio_currpreg, m_preeclam, pprom_currpreg)

gapps_AJOG_selected <- gapps_AJOGvars %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, m_category___9) #Cervical insufficiency

#Combine GAPPS covar sets
gapps_selected_covars <- full_join(gapps_main_selected_covars, oldgapps_selected_covars, by=c("pathways_id"))

gapps_selected_covars <- full_join(gapps_selected_covars, gapps_AJOG_selected, by=c("pathways_id"))

#Old CANDLE
#need to pull income
oldcandle_selected_covars <- old_candle_covar %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, h_m_delivery_age)

#CANDLE Covar 3- pull sPTB filtering variables
CANDLE_missingcovars2 <- CANDLE_Covariates3 %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, m_chorio, m_preeclam, m1mb_chtn, m1mb_chtn2, ld_gesthtn4, ld_cshtn, ld_mhtn, pprom_currpreg)

#Combine CANDLE covar sets
candle_selected_covars <- inner_join(candle_main_selected_covars, oldcandle_selected_covars, by=c("pathways_id"))

candle_selected_covars <- inner_join(candle_selected_covars, CANDLE_missingcovars2, by=c("pathways_id"))

#Add batch to each dataset
candle_selected_covars<- inner_join(candle_selected_covars, candle_batch,by=c("pathways_id"))
gapps_selected_covars <- inner_join(gapps_selected_covars, gapps_batch, by=c("pathways_id"))
gapps_selected_covars <- gapps_selected_covars %>%
  dplyr::select(-original_batch)

#Fix GAPPS study site
summary(as.factor(gapps_selected_covars$site))
gapps_selected_covars$site <- recode(gapps_selected_covars$site, `10` = "Seattle", `11` = "Seattle", `12` = "Yakima")
summary(as.factor(gapps_selected_covars$site))

```

### Fix 8888 Variables
Some variables are coded as 8888 which means "prefer not to respond"- these will be recoded as NAs.
```{r fix 8888}

candle_selected_covars[candle_selected_covars == 8888 | candle_selected_covars == "8888"] <- NA


#check one var with 8888 before and after
summary(as.factor(gapps_selected_covars$h_m_race))
gapps_selected_covars[gapps_selected_covars == 8888 | gapps_selected_covars == "8888"] <- NA
summary(as.factor(gapps_selected_covars$h_m_race))
```

### Summarize covariates
Summarize to make sure everything looks right before performing filtering
```{r summarize preliminary}
summary(candle_selected_covars)
summary(gapps_selected_covars)
```

### Remove multiple gestations and placental abruptions
CANDLE only has singletons. We will remove placental abruption from both cohorts here too.
```{r remove exclusion critera}
#GAPPS
dim(gapps_selected_covars) #465
gapps_afterexclusion<- gapps_selected_covars %>%
  dplyr::filter(h_multi_gest==0|is.na(h_multi_gest)) %>% #452 after removing multiple gestatons
  dplyr::filter(h_placental_abrupt==0|is.na(h_placental_abrupt)) %>% #438 after removing placental abruption
  dplyr::select(-h_multi_gest, -h_placental_abrupt)
dim(gapps_afterexclusion)

#CANDLE
dim(candle_selected_covars) #465
candle_afterexclusion <- candle_selected_covars %>%
  dplyr::filter(h_placental_abrupt==0|is.na(h_placental_abrupt)) %>% #788 after removing placental abruption
  dplyr::select( -h_placental_abrupt)
dim(candle_afterexclusion)

```

### Organize Data for Combining
Make sure column names are shared
```{r organize}

# Add Cohort Marker
candle_afterexclusion$Cohort <- c("CANDLE")
gapps_afterexclusion$Cohort <- c("GAPPS")
#Harmonize column names
colnames(candle_afterexclusion) <- c("pathways_id","BMI", "Education", "Race", "Ethnicity", "FetalSex", "Parity", "LaborType", "DeliveryMethod", "Smoking", "Alcohol", "GestAgeWks", "Birthweight", "Site", "Age", "m_chorio", "m_preeclam", "m1mb_chtn", "m1mb_chtn2", "ld_gesthtn4", "ld_cshtn", "ld_mhtn", "pprom_currpreg", "Batch", "Cohort")


colnames(gapps_afterexclusion) <- c("pathways_id", "Age", "BMI", "Education", "Race", "Ethnicity", "FetalSex", "Parity", "LaborType", "DeliveryMethod", "Smoking", "GestAgeDays", "Birthweight","PlacentalWeight1", "PlacentalWeight2", "Site", "Alcohol", "m_chorio_currpreg", "m_preeclam", "pprom_currpreg", "m_category___9", "Batch", "Cohort")

#Harmonize gstational age variables by having weeks and days option for each cohort
candle_afterexclusion$GestAgeDays <- (candle_afterexclusion$GestAgeWks)*7
gapps_afterexclusion$GestAgeWks <- (gapps_afterexclusion$GestAgeDays)/7

#Remove covariates that won't be needed for the BW and GestAGe analysis in combined CANDLE+ GAPPS. We'll revisit these covariates for other analyses
gapps_covars_forcombining <- gapps_afterexclusion %>%
  dplyr::select(-PlacentalWeight1, -PlacentalWeight2, -m_chorio_currpreg, -m_preeclam,-pprom_currpreg, -m_category___9)

candle_covars_forcombining <- candle_afterexclusion %>%
  dplyr::select(-m_chorio, -m_preeclam, -m1mb_chtn, -m1mb_chtn2, -ld_gesthtn4, -ld_cshtn, -ld_mhtn, -pprom_currpreg)

#Reorder GAPPS Columns to Match CANDLE
sum(colnames(gapps_covars_forcombining)==colnames(candle_covars_forcombining))
sum(colnames(gapps_covars_forcombining) %in% colnames(candle_covars_forcombining))
gapps_covars_forcombining <- gapps_covars_forcombining[, colnames(candle_covars_forcombining)]
sum(colnames(gapps_covars_forcombining)==colnames(candle_covars_forcombining))
```

### Combine CANDLE and GAPPS Data
```{r combine cohorts}
CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars <- rbind(candle_covars_forcombining, gapps_covars_forcombining)
CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars$Cohort <- as.factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars$Cohort)
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars)
```

### GAPPS Only: Fix Placental Weight Vars and Remove NAs
There are a small number of GAPPS participants with two placental weight measurements. Will take the average for those participants. Note that only GAPPS has placental weight data. 
```{r placental weight}
#Grab samples with two weights
placentalweight_problems <- gapps_afterexclusion %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, PlacentalWeight1, PlacentalWeight2) %>%
  dplyr::filter(PlacentalWeight1 != "NA" & PlacentalWeight2 !="NA")
#Take average
placentalweight_problems$AvgPlacentalWeight <- ((placentalweight_problems$PlacentalWeight1+ placentalweight_problems$PlacentalWeight2)/2)
#Pull pathways ID of problems samples
prob_PW <- placentalweight_problems$pathways_id

#Remove old weights
placentalweight_problems <- placentalweight_problems %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, AvgPlacentalWeight)
colnames(placentalweight_problems) <- c("pathways_id", "PlacentalWeight")

#Pull PW1
placentalweight <- gapps_afterexclusion %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, PlacentalWeight1) %>%
  dplyr::filter(! pathways_id %in% prob_PW)
colnames(placentalweight) <- c("pathways_id", "PlacentalWeight")

#New PW
new_PW <-rbind(placentalweight, placentalweight_problems)
summary(new_PW$PlacentalWeight)

# Prepare other variables to readd new_PW
gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency <- gapps_afterexclusion %>%
  dplyr::select(-PlacentalWeight1, -PlacentalWeight2, -m_chorio_currpreg, -m_preeclam,-pprom_currpreg, -m_category___9) #no longer need the old placenta weight variables, also removing some fo the variables needed for the sPTB analysis
gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency <- full_join(gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency, new_PW, by=c("pathways_id"))
dim(gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency)
```

### Remove Participants with Missing Data
-Remove participants with missing data. Only participants with complete covariates will be retained.
```{r exclusion}
dim(CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars)
CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars <- CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars %>%
  na.omit()
sum(is.na(CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars))
dim(CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars)
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars$Cohort)

#GAPPS only Covariates (for BW/PW analyess)- NAs already removed above
dim(gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency)
gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency <- gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency %>% 
  na.omit()
dim(gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency)
```

### Load Exposure/Proportion Data to Cross Check
Need to ensure that these participants have: 
Cell Proportions Data (Derived from RNAseq Data)
```{r load extra data}
CibersortResults <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/FromBrennan/Data/CIBERSORTx_Job8_Results.csv")
```

### Check for Deconvolution Data Overlap
```{r deconvo overlap}
#Combined CANDLE/GAPPS
sum(CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars$pathways_id %in% CibersortResults$Mixture)
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars <- CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars %>%
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% CibersortResults$Mixture)

summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars$Cohort)

#GAPPS Only: PW Data
sum(gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency$pathways_id %in% CibersortResults$Mixture)
gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars <- gapps_forPlacentalEfficiency %>%
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% CibersortResults$Mixture)
```

### Calculate BW:PW Ratio for GAPPS Only Data
Birthweight in grams divided by placental weight in grams.
```{r BWPW}
gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$BWPW <- gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$Birthweight/gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$PlacentalWeight
```

### Investigate Cotinine Data to decide about Smoking Composite Variable
Going to make a composite smoking variable where if smoking self-report or cotinine are detected it is a yes and if neither are detected it is a no. 
```{r cotinine organize}
# Pull Cotinine Variables
CANDLE_cotinine <- candle_covars %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, cotinine_yn_m1, cotinine_yn_m2)
#GAPPS cotinine measurement is inside the phthalates data
Phthalates_GAPPS <- read.csv("/Volumes/paquette_a/slapehn/CellProportions_CANDLE_GAPPS/Data/PhthalateData/gapps_phthalates_042524.csv")
GAPPS_cotinine <- Phthalates_GAPPS %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, cotinine_contact_type, cotinine_yn)

#Make CANDLE cotinine into Factors
CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m1 <- as.factor(CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m1)
CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m2 <- as.factor(CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m2)

# Reduce to only participants with full_covars
CANDLE_cotinine <- CANDLE_cotinine %>%
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$pathways_id)
GAPPS_cotinine <- GAPPS_cotinine %>%
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$pathways_id)

#Aggregate GAPPS data by participants 
GAPPS_cotinine_agg <- aggregate(cotinine_yn ~ pathways_id, data = GAPPS_cotinine, sum)
GAPPS_cotinine_agg$Cotinine_composite <- as.factor(ifelse(GAPPS_cotinine_agg$cotinine_yn==1, "Yes", "No"))
summary(GAPPS_cotinine_agg$Cotinine_composite)
#Only two participants with cotinine detected at least once vs.4 for self-report. Both cotinine participants were detected by self-report already

#Calculate for CANDLE
#Impute NAs as 0 for CANDLE for easier classification- checked that all participants had at least 1 cotinine measure 
CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m1[is.na(CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m1)] <- 0
CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m2[is.na(CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m2)] <- 0
## Calculate Cotinine Detection as Yes or No across visits
CANDLE_cotinine$Cotinine_composite <- as.factor(ifelse(CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m1==1 & CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m2==1 | CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m1==1 & CANDLE_cotinine$cotinine_yn_m2==0 , "Yes", "No"))

summary(CANDLE_cotinine$Cotinine_composite)

#Check how well cotinine data overlaps with self-report
CotCANDLEIDs <- CANDLE_cotinine %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cotinine_composite == "Yes")
CANDLESelfReportSmoke <- CANDLE_GAPPS_Covars %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cohort=="CANDLE", Smoking==1)
sum(CotCANDLEIDs$pathways_id %in% CANDLESelfReportSmoke$pathways_id)

#Combine CANDLE/GAPPS cotinine into one variable
GAPPS_cot_final <- GAPPS_cotinine_agg %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, Cotinine_composite)
CANDLE_cot_final <- CANDLE_cotinine %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, Cotinine_composite)

CANDLE_GAPPS_Cotinine <- rbind(GAPPS_cot_final, CANDLE_cot_final)

# Add to Covars
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars <- full_join(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars, CANDLE_GAPPS_Cotinine, by=("pathways_id"))

```

### Organize Cotinine Data for gappsonly dataset
```{r gappsonly cot}
GAPPSonly_cotinine <- GAPPS_cotinine %>%
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$pathways_id)

GAPPSonly_cotinine_agg <- aggregate(cotinine_yn ~ pathways_id, data = GAPPSonly_cotinine, sum)
GAPPSonly_cotinine_agg$Cotinine_composite <- as.factor(ifelse(GAPPSonly_cotinine_agg$cotinine_yn==1, "Yes", "No"))
summary(GAPPSonly_cotinine_agg$Cotinine_composite)

# Add to Covars
gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars <- full_join(gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars, GAPPSonly_cotinine_agg, by=("pathways_id"))
```

### Make Smoking Composite Variable
Composite variable = Yes if at least one timepoint per participant has positive cotinine or positive smoking self-report. 
```{r smoking composite}
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite <- ifelse(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Smoking==1 | CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$Cotinine_composite=="Yes", "Yes", "No")
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite <-as.factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)
#the 7 NA is from a GAPPS participant with no cotinine measures but 0 as smoking self-report will turn to "No" for the composite
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite[is.na(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)] <- "No"
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)

### GAPPS only Smoking Composite
gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite <- ifelse(gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$Smoking==1 | gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$Cotinine_composite=="Yes", "Yes", "No")
gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite <-as.factor(gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)
summary(gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)
#there are 6 NAs from GAPPS participants that don't have cotinine data, but these participants do have self-report data listed as 0- so will impute these as No for the composite
gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite[is.na(gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)] <- "No"
summary(gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)

```

### Make sPTB Data
Need to remove participants with inductions or no labor for the preterm birth analysis as well as other cohort specific exclusion criteria as outlined in Paquette et al. 2023 AJOG.
```{r sPTB Data}
#First need to separately filter the datasets since there are some unique exclusion criteria for each cohort

#Filter CANDLE for sPTB using AJOG criteria
dim(candle_selected_covars)
#check some totals for a few variables
summary(as.factor(candle_selected_covars$m_chorio))
summary(as.factor(candle_selected_covars$m_preeclam))
summary(as.factor(candle_selected_covars$m1mb_chtn))
summary(as.factor(candle_selected_covars$m1mb_chtn2))
summary(as.factor(candle_selected_covars$ld_gesthtn4))
summary(as.factor(candle_selected_covars$ld_cshtn))
summary(as.factor(candle_selected_covars$ld_mhtn))
#Only keep 0's and NAs for these variables then remove the variables
#Note: Placental Abruption already removed
candle_sPTB_exclusion <- candle_selected_covars %>%
  dplyr::filter(cg_labor_type %in% c(1,2,4)) %>% #529 after removing inductions
  dplyr::filter(m_chorio==0 | is.na(m_chorio)) %>% #525 after removing chorioamnionitis
  dplyr::filter(m_preeclam==0 | is.na(m_preeclam)) %>% #525 after removing preelampsia
  dplyr::filter(m1mb_chtn ==0 | is.na(m1mb_chtn)) %>% #525 after removing Chronic hypertension in current pregnancy at M1 visit 
  dplyr::filter(m1mb_chtn2==0 | is.na(m1mb_chtn2)) %>% #525 after removing chronit hypertension ever
  dplyr::filter(ld_gesthtn4 == 0|is.na(ld_gesthtn4)) %>% #497 after removing PE or gHTN diagnoses since last visit at delivery
  dplyr::filter(ld_cshtn==0 | is.na(ld_cshtn)) %>% #496 after removing C-section indication: PE/HTN
  dplyr::filter(ld_mhtn==0 | is.na(ld_mhtn)) %>% #496 after removing delivery classification= PTB-PE/HTN
  dplyr::select(-h_placental_abrupt, -m_chorio, -m_preeclam, -m1mb_chtn, -m1mb_chtn2, -ld_gesthtn4, -ld_cshtn, -ld_mhtn)
dim(candle_sPTB_exclusion) #496

sum(candle_sPTB_exclusion$pathways_id %in% CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$pathways_id)

#Filter GAPPS for sPTB (based on AJOG paper criteria)
dim(gapps_selected_covars)
#check some totals for a few variables
summary(as.factor(gapps_selected_covars$m_chorio_currpreg))
summary(as.factor(gapps_selected_covars$m_preeclam))
summary(as.factor(gapps_selected_covars$m_category___9))
#Only keep 0's and NAs for these variables then remove the variables
#Note: already removed multiple gestations and placental abruptions earlier
gapps_sPTB_exclusion <- gapps_selected_covars %>% #465 to start
  dplyr::filter(cg_labor_type %in% c(1,2,4)) %>% #301 after removing inductions
  dplyr::filter(m_chorio_currpreg==0|is.na(m_chorio_currpreg)) %>% #287 after removing chorioamnionitis
  dplyr::filter(m_preeclam==0|is.na(m_preeclam)) %>% #283 after removing preeclampsia
  dplyr::filter(m_category___9==0|is.na(m_category___9)) %>% #274 after removing cervical insufficiency
  dplyr::select(-h_multi_gest, -h_placental_abrupt, -m_chorio_currpreg, -m_preeclam, -m_category___9, -m_pl1_weight, -m_pl2_weight)
dim(gapps_sPTB_exclusion) #274


#Prepare to combine

# Add Cohort Marker
candle_sPTB_exclusion$Cohort <- c("CANDLE")
gapps_sPTB_exclusion$Cohort <- c("GAPPS")

#Harmonize column names
colnames(candle_sPTB_exclusion) <- c("pathways_id","BMI", "Education", "Race", "Ethnicity", "FetalSex", "Parity", "LaborType", "DeliveryMethod", "Smoking", "Alcohol", "GestAgeWks", "Birthweight", "Site", "Age", "PPROM", "Batch", "Cohort")


colnames(gapps_sPTB_exclusion) <- c("pathways_id", "Age", "BMI", "Education", "Race", "Ethnicity", "FetalSex", "Parity", "LaborType", "DeliveryMethod", "Smoking", "GestAgeDays", "Birthweight", "Site", "Alcohol",  "PPROM", "Batch", "Cohort")

#Harmonize gstational age variables by having weeks and days option for each cohort
candle_sPTB_exclusion$GestAgeDays <- (candle_sPTB_exclusion$GestAgeWks)*7
gapps_sPTB_exclusion$GestAgeWks <- (gapps_sPTB_exclusion$GestAgeDays)/7

#Reorder GAPPS Columns to Match CANDLE
sum(colnames(gapps_sPTB_exclusion)==colnames(candle_sPTB_exclusion))
sum(colnames(gapps_sPTB_exclusion) %in% colnames(candle_sPTB_exclusion))
gapps_sPTB_exclusion <- gapps_sPTB_exclusion[, colnames(candle_sPTB_exclusion)]
sum(colnames(gapps_sPTB_exclusion)==colnames(candle_sPTB_exclusion))

#Remove participants with incomplete covariates
dim(gapps_sPTB_exclusion)
gapps_sPTB_complete <- na.omit(gapps_sPTB_exclusion)
dim(gapps_sPTB_complete)


dim(candle_sPTB_exclusion)
candle_sPTB_complete <- na.omit(candle_sPTB_exclusion)
dim(candle_sPTB_complete)

#Combine
candle_gapps_sPTB <- rbind(candle_sPTB_complete, gapps_sPTB_complete)
dim(candle_gapps_sPTB)

#Make sure that cell deconvolution data is available for all of these participants
sum(candle_gapps_sPTB$pathways_id %in% CibersortResults$Mixture)
CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars <- candle_gapps_sPTB %>%
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% CibersortResults$Mixture)
dim(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars)

summary(as.factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$Cohort))

#Add PTB Variable

CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$PTB <- as.factor(ifelse(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$GestAgeWks<37, "Yes", "No"))
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$PTB)

#Make Labor Status Variable
CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$LaborStatus <- as.factor(ifelse(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$LaborType %in% c(1,2), "yes", "no"))
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$LaborStatus)
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$LaborType)

#Add Smoking Composite-pulling from the larger CANDLE/GAPPS cohort
CANDLE_cotinine2 <- candle_covars %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, cotinine_yn_m1, cotinine_yn_m2)

GAPPS_cotinine2 <- Phthalates_GAPPS %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, cotinine_contact_type, cotinine_yn)

#Make CANDLE cotinine into Factors
CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m1 <- as.factor(CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m1)
CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m2 <- as.factor(CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m2)

# Reduce to only participants with full_covars
CANDLE_cotinine2 <- CANDLE_cotinine2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$pathways_id)
GAPPS_cotinine2 <- GAPPS_cotinine2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(pathways_id %in% CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$pathways_id)

#Aggregate GAPPS data by participants 
GAPPS_cotinine_agg2 <- aggregate(cotinine_yn ~ pathways_id, data = GAPPS_cotinine2, sum)
GAPPS_cotinine_agg2$Cotinine_composite <- as.factor(ifelse(GAPPS_cotinine_agg2$cotinine_yn==1, "Yes", "No"))
summary(GAPPS_cotinine_agg2$Cotinine_composite)
summary(gapps_sPTB_complete$Smoking)
#Only two participants with cotinine detected at least once vs.4 for self-report. Both cotinine participants were detected by self-report already

#Calculate for CANDLE
#Impute NAs as 0 for CANDLE for easier classification- checked that all participants had at least 1 cotinine measure 
CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m1[is.na(CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m1)] <- 0
CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m2[is.na(CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m2)] <- 0
## Calculate Cotinine Detection as Yes or No across visits
CANDLE_cotinine2$Cotinine_composite <- as.factor(ifelse(CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m1==1 & CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m2==1 | CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m1==1 & CANDLE_cotinine2$cotinine_yn_m2==0 , "Yes", "No"))

summary(CANDLE_cotinine2$Cotinine_composite)

#Check how well cotinine data overlaps with self-report
CotCANDLEIDs2 <- CANDLE_cotinine2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cotinine_composite == "Yes")
CANDLESelfReportSmoke2 <- CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars %>%
  dplyr::filter(Cohort=="CANDLE", Smoking==1)
sum(CotCANDLEIDs2$pathways_id %in% CANDLESelfReportSmoke2$pathways_id)

#Combine CANDLE/GAPPS cotinine into one variable
GAPPS_cot_final2 <- GAPPS_cotinine_agg2 %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, Cotinine_composite)
CANDLE_cot_final2 <- CANDLE_cotinine2 %>%
  dplyr::select(pathways_id, Cotinine_composite)

CANDLE_GAPPS_Cotinine2 <- rbind(GAPPS_cot_final2, CANDLE_cot_final2)

# Add to Covars
dim(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars)
dim(CANDLE_GAPPS_Cotinine2)
CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars <- full_join(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars, CANDLE_GAPPS_Cotinine2, by=("pathways_id"))

#Make Smoking Composite Variable

CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite <- ifelse(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$Smoking==1 | CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$Cotinine_composite=="Yes", "Yes", "No")
CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite <-as.factor(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)
#the 3 NA is from a GAPPS participant with no cotinine measures but 0 as smoking self-report will turn to "No" for the composite
CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite[is.na(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)] <- "No"
summary(CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$SmokingComposite)

```

### Calculate BW Z-Scores
CAlculate BW Z-Score using Intergrowth-21. We only need BW Z-score for the N=1009 CANDLE/GAPPS dataset, so not calculating for the others right now.
```{r zscore}
CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars <- CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars %>%
  mutate(
    BW_kg = Birthweight / 1000,
    FetalSex_full = recode(FetalSex, "M" = "Male", "F" = "Female"))

CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$bw_z <- igb_wtkg2zscore(
  sex = CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$FetalSex_full,
  ga = CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$GestAgeDays,
  wtkg = CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$BW_kg
)

#Make some plots
#Plot GA in Days vs. Wt. in Kg
plot(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$BW_kg, CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$GestAgeDays)
#Plot histogram of Z-score
hist(CANDLE_GAPPS_FinalCovars$bw_z)


### Also going to calculate for the other covar sets for the main summary table
CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars <- CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars %>%
  mutate(
    BW_kg = Birthweight / 1000,
    FetalSex_full = recode(FetalSex, "M" = "Male", "F" = "Female"))

CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$bw_z <- igb_wtkg2zscore(
  sex = CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$FetalSex_full,
  ga = CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$GestAgeDays,
  wtkg = CANDLE_GAPPS_sPTB_FinalCovars$BW_kg
)


gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars <- gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars %>%
  mutate(
    BW_kg = Birthweight / 1000,
    FetalSex_full = recode(FetalSex, "M" = "Male", "F" = "Female"))

gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$bw_z <- igb_wtkg2zscore(
  sex = gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$FetalSex_full,
  ga = gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$GestAgeDays,
  wtkg = gappsonly_PW_FinalCovars$BW_kg
)


```
